name: Water Elemental
description: An elemental is a powerful fusion of raw magic and elements resulting in a formidable foe that can channel magic. Elementals are typically prevalent in groups and in locations that are infused with ancient magic or extraplanar energy.

actions.name: Ice Strike
actions.description: The Water Elemental strikes a creature, dealing ice damage. On a true hit, the targeted creature must make a resilience check against the total damage taken after mitigations or become frozen until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Waterwave
actions.description: The Water Elemental sacrifices some of it's essence and targets an unoccupied tile 6 units away and turns itself into a wave of water that travels in a line 6 units long and 1 unit wide to that point, dealing cold damage. The Water Elemental moves to the unoccupied tile without provoking reactions and takes 2d4 true damage.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving the Water Elemental's area of control, it makes an attack against them with it's Ice Strike action.

actions.name: Smash
actions.description: The Water Elemental forms a limb made of water and smashes a creature with it, dealing physical damage.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.description: Elementals have special protection against physical damage from weapons and ammunition that do not have the magical property, halving any damage before mitigations are applied.

traits.name: Essence of Water
traits.description: The Water Elementaling gains a 1d4 bonus to attack checks while submerged in water.
